title: HealthBench-Psych: A Mental Health Subset of OpenAI's HealthBench
abstract: arXiv:2608.25071v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: General-purpose health benchmarks increasingly anchor claims about LLM medical performance, but they are not always resolved by clinical specialty, making domain-specific performance hard to isolate. Mental health is of acute public-health concern as millions of people turn to LLMs for psychological support, and most existing evaluations are bespoke academic benchmarks that are difficult to integrate into developer workflows. We introduce HealthBench-Psych and HealthBench-Psych-Hard. We screened HealthBench's 5,000 physician-rubric conversations for mental-health relevance with a transparent LLM-applied rubric, then validated the subset through two rounds of blinded clinician review with concealed known-exclude controls, yielding 610 conversations (12.2% of the corpus). translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25071v1 公告类型：新 摘要：通用健康基准日益成为关于大语言模型医疗性能声明的基础，但它们并不总是按临床专科细分，这使得特定领域的性能难以单独评估。心理健康是一个紧迫的公共卫生问题，因为数百万人转向大语言模型寻求心理支持，而现有的大多数评估都是定制化的学术基准，难以整合到开发者工作流程中。我们引入了HealthBench-Psych和HealthBench-Psych-Hard。我们使用一个透明的、由大语言模型应用的评分标准筛选了HealthBench的5,000个医生评分对话，以确定其与心理健康的相关性，然后通过两轮盲审临床医生审查（含隐藏的已知排除对照）验证该子集，最终得到610个对话（占语料库的12.2%）。在三个大语言模型评审员组成的跨供应商小组下评估了20个前沿和开放模型，我们发现了一个统计上并列的前沿模型集群，以及两个模型中的可测量拒绝行为。
tldr: 本文从OpenAI HealthBench中筛选并验证了心理健康相关子集，创建了HealthBench-Psych基准，用于评估大语言模型在心理健康领域的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper filters and validates a mental-health-relevant subset from OpenAI's HealthBench, creating the HealthBench-Psych benchmark for evaluating LLM performance in mental health.
